heading: A continuing inquiry into the rules of complex systems.
home_summary: Grand Quest carries forward the spirit of an earlier NSF Big Ideas project led by Hyejin Youn, bringing core collaborators together again to study the evolution of rules.

previous.title: A unified science of regulation
previous.program: NSF Big Ideas · Understanding the Rules of Life
previous.description: Led by Hyejin Youn, this earlier project sought common principles of regulatory functions and networks across biological and social systems. It asked how regulatory structures emerge, why their costs grow, and how regulation supports complex systems.

current.title: Toward a Science of Rules
current.description: The completed project’s intellectual and collaborative spirit lives on in Grand Quest. Core members of the earlier collaboration reunite to examine how rules evolve and how AI may change the dynamics of institutional self-correction.

connection: From the principles of regulation across systems to the evolution of rules—and the possibilities introduced by AI.
